battle.name: 隋滅高寶寧之戰
battle.brief: 開皇三年（583）冬，隋文帝分道伐陳，陳將高寶寧所部在合肥、巢湖一線的江北前線拒戰，兵敗被擒，所守城邑為隋軍所據。此役未能渡江，卻替隋在淮南整備漕運、造船積穀，開啟往後六年的滅陳工程。卡面亞述長矛並非此戰裝備，只作對照：短柄長刃的近身刺擊原理，正是隋軍步卒長矛與陳軍槊陣共通之處。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭是開皇三年隋文帝第一次大舉攻陳的前哨，交戰兩方是北方的隋與南方的陳。隋是楊堅於北周大定元年受禪建立的王朝，都城大興城，開皇三年時已盡有北周留下的中原與河北版圖；府兵制經周、隋兩代整頓，軍戶歸籍、將府分置，兵權集中於尚書省與行軍元帥，糧秣則靠關中、河南與江淮的屯田與漕運接濟。陳是南朝末代王朝，都城建康，此時疆域僅存長江以南，陳後主在位，朝政由施文慶、蔡大寶一班文臣與蕭摩訶、章昭達、歐陽頠一班宿將分掌，軍隊則被史書評為「甲兵寡弱」。開皇三年十月，隋文帝詔令晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，秦王楊秀、蜀王楊俊、漢王楊諒各領一路，賀若弼、韓擒虎、楊素、高頎等宿將配屬諸軍，自廣陵、濠州、廬州、湘州數路推向江淮；陳方則以高寶寧等將領分守長江中游的城邑與津渡，據險以拒。兩國的差距不在個別名將，而在總體國力：隋能一次抽出數十萬眾並持續六年前進，陳只能依靠長江天險與有限的州郡兵與之相持。
countriesEn: This war was the opening move of Emperor Wen of Sui's first great offensive against Chen in the Kaihuang third year, and the two sides in it were the northern Sui and the southern Chen. Sui was the dynasty Yang Jian had founded by accepting the abdication of Northern Zhou in the Dading first year, with its capital at Daxing; by the Kaihuang third year it already held all the Central Plain and Hebei territory that Northern Zhou had left behind. Its fu-bing military system had been put in order through the Zhou and Sui reigns, with military households registered, commanderies and general-offices separated, and the right to command troops concentrated in the Department of State Affairs and the commander-in-chief; its grain and supplies came from the tuntian fields and the canal transport of Guanzhong, Henan and Jianghuai. Chen was the last dynasty of the southern courts, with its capital at Jiankang, and by now its territory was nothing but the land south of the Yangtze. Under Emperor Hou of Chen, the government was divided between a set of civil officials such as Shi Wenqing and Cai Dabao and a set of seasoned commanders such as Xiao Mohe, Zhang Zhaoda and Ouyang Wei, and its troops were described in the histories as slender in armour and few in number. In the tenth month of the Kaihuang third year, Emperor Wen of Sui ordered Prince Jin Yang Guang to serve as commander-in-chief, with Prince Qin Yang Xiu, Prince Shu Yang Jun and Prince Han Yang Liang each commanding a separate route, and veteran generals such as He Ruobi, Han Qinhu, Yang Su and Gao Jiao attached to the armies, pressing towards the Yangtze valley from Guangling, Haozhou, Luzhou and Xiangzhou. On the Chen side, commanders such as Gao Baoning were posted to hold the towns and fords of the middle Yangtze and to hold the ground on the strength of its difficult positions. The difference between the two countries lay not in any individual general but in overall national strength: Sui could detach tens of thousands of troops in a single movement and keep pushing forward for six years, while Chen could only hold on by the natural barrier of the Yangtze and the limited troops of its commanderies.
people: 正史對此役留下的記載極為簡略，高寶寧本人的行止只在總敘中佔了一行，無法細述其年歲、籍貫與仕歷；能確定的是，他是開皇三年陳朝派在長江中游前線的一線將領，領兵拒隋，兵敗被擒，或死於亂軍，其生死去向上兩說並存，而所部潰散、所守城邑易手則是無爭的。與他同列的陳方人物中，陳後主陳叔寶坐鎮建康，主持朝議與調兵；施文慶、蔡大寶以中書舍人、吏部尚書之職掌管文書與銓選，是陳廷應對隋軍時的決策中樞；蕭摩訶以驍勇著稱，領南徐州刺史，是陳方最精銳的騎兵統帥；章昭達守湘州，歐陽頠鎮南康，張彪、王固分守建康外圍，司馬消難、淳于量、裴忌各領一州之兵。隋方人才濟濟：文帝楊堅下詔出兵，晉王楊廣以皇子身份總制軍務，兼領淮南行省尚書令，於揚州一線造船積穀、置軍備糧；秦王楊秀、蜀王楊俊、漢王楊諒各統一軍；賀若弼自廣陵方向西進，韓擒虎自濠州、廬州方向南下，楊素、高頎分當西路與後方督運之任；虞慶、賀蘭楚、麥鐵杖等將校亦在行伍之間。往後的際遇更能說明這批人的分量：開皇九年滅陳時，麥鐵杖中流矢而歿，楊素在長江中游接下東線壓力，而陳方的蕭摩訶在采石以火船焚隋軍戰船，一度令隋軍付出萬計的傷亡；正是用這樣的代價，陳朝換來了六年的苟安。
peopleEn: The official record is extremely thin for this war, and Gao Baoning's own movements take up only a single line in the general narrative, so his age, native place and career cannot be set out in detail. What can be established is that he was a front-line commander posted by Chen to the middle Yangtze in the Kaihuang third year, that he led troops to resist Sui, that he was defeated and captured, or died in the rout, with both accounts of his fate current, and that his troops broke up and the towns he had held changed hands — that much is not in dispute. Among the Chen figures of the same rank, Emperor Hou of Chen, Chen Shubao, sat at Jiankang presiding over the court's deliberations and the movement of troops; Shi Wenqing and Cai Dabao, holding the posts of secretariat divisional official and minister of the personnel department, managed the documents and the appointments and were the decision-making core of the Chen court as it answered the Sui army; Xiao Mohe, famed for his valour and holding the post of governor of South Xuzhou, commanded Chen's finest cavalry; Zhang Zhaoda held Xiangzhou, Ouyang Wei held Nankang, Zhang Biao and Wang Gu each guarded the approaches to Jiankang, and Sima Xiaonan, Chunyu Liang and Pei Ji led the troops of their own provinces. On the Sui side the roster was crowded: Emperor Wen Yang Jian issued the order to march, Prince Jin Yang Guang, as a son of the imperial house, took charge of military affairs and at the same time held the post of department director of the Jiangnan Circuit at Yangzhou, where ships were built and grain stored and the army supplied; Princes Qin Yang Xiu, Shu Yang Jun and Han Yang Liang each commanded an army; He Ruobi advanced westward from Guangling, Han Qinhu moved south from Haozhou and Luzhou, and Yang Su and Gao Jiao took charge of the western route and of command of the rear; officers such as Yu Qing, Helan Chu and Mai Tiezhang stood in the ranks as well. The later fates of these men show their weight all the better: at the conquest of Chen in the ninth year of Kaihuang, Mai Tiezhang was killed by a stray arrow, Yang Su took the pressure of the eastern front in the middle Yangtze, and Chen's Xiao Mohe burned the Sui war-ships with fire boats at Caishi, costing the Sui army a loss that the histories put at ten thousand men. It was a price of that kind that bought Chen six years of uneasy survival.
kits: 卡面那支亞述長矛屬於公元前九世紀兩河流域的兵器，與隋軍的裝備沒有任何傳承關係，只能當作對照件：它短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃，是徒手近身刺擊用的兵器，在亞述人的攻城與野戰裡，與弓、鐵器、投石和撞車配套使用，攻破城門之後的巷戰才是它的舞臺。隋軍此戰實際動用的東西，與亞述差距極大。裝甲方面，隋軍步兵與陳軍都穿鐵札甲，扣綴成排，上綴於兜鍪之下，前面或執大盾，或以長槊應敵；近戰兵器是環首刀與長矛（槊），弓弩並行，張弩與蹶張弩是野戰與攻城時的骨幹投射火力。攻城器械包括雲梯、巢車、撞車、投石車與火箭，《隋書》記後來平陳時，隋軍曾以猛火油灌注城樓與守禦的櫓具，一炬而盡。舟師方面，隋在開皇八年之後大造五牙大艦與黃龍艦，艦上設樓，置拍竿，準備渡江；陳朝水軍則有樓船、走舸、鬥艦、蒙衝、艅艟等船型，兵船之間以鐵索貫連成陣，火箭與火船為其常備。運輸方面，江淮糧秣靠運河水運與牛車陸運並行，屯田所出供軍，一船之量、一牛之載，決定了數千里長途能走多遠。亞述長矛唯一可以借鑑的，是它那個「短柄、長刃、貼身刺穿」的力學取向：亞述人用它對付盾牌與城門之後的守軍，隋軍的長槊在原理上正是同一件事，只是把刃延長、身量放大，並交給雙手去握。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card belongs to the ninth century BCE in Mesopotamia and stands in no line of succession to the equipment of the Sui army; it can serve only as a comparison piece. It has a short haft, a long blade and an iron head, and it is a weapon for thrusting at close quarters with the hands alone. In the sieges and field fights of the Assyrians it was used together with the bow, iron tools, stone-throwing engines and battering rams, and the street fighting after a city gate had been broken open was where it did its work. What the Sui army actually used in this war was very far from the Assyrian. On armour, Sui infantry and Chen troops alike wore iron lamellar armour fastened in rows and mounted beneath a helmet, and they carried either a large shield in front or a long sa spear; the close-combat weapons were the ring-pommel sword and the long spear, with bow and crossbow alongside, the tensioned crossbow and the strong-armed draw crossbow forming the backbone of missile work in the field and at the walls. The siege train included scaling ladders, siege towers, battering rams, stone-throwing engines and fire-arrows; the Sui shu records that in the later conquest of Chen the Sui poured burning oil onto the city towers and the wooden towers on the walls, and a single fire consumed them. On the water, after the eighth year of Kaihuang Sui built great five-deck ships and yellow-dragon ships in numbers, with towers on them and stone-throwing beams set up, in preparation for the crossing; the Chen navy had its own types — tower ships, swift galleys, fighting galleys, ram ships and light fast vessels — with the warships linked in line by iron chains, and fire-arrows and fire-ships kept ready. On transport, the grain of Jianghuai moved both by canal and by ox-wagon, with what the tuntian fields produced feeding the army; the measure of a boat and the measure of an ox decided how far a march of several thousand li could actually go. The single thing that can be taken from the Assyrian spear is its mechanical orientation: short haft, long blade, thrust driven home at close range. The Assyrians used it against shields and against the defenders behind a city gate, and the long sa of the Sui infantry was the same idea in principle, only with a longer blade, a larger frame, and the weight of it handed to two hands.
tactics: 開皇三年這一波出兵，隋的目標並非立刻渡江滅陳，而是先在江淮一線站住腳：正史說得很清楚，隋文帝是以行軍元帥分道併進，兵鋒指向陳朝在長江中游與下游的外圍城邑，奪其津渡、障其接應，再把糧秣與舟師的基地安到淮南。攻城與野戰的打法是當時通行的組合：先以弩手分隊列陣，壓制城頭守軍的射界，使守軍不能平射；再以雲梯、巢車、撞車、投石車逼近，撞門、塞火道、拔旗幟；門一破，步卒即持大盾、長槊蜂而入，靠短兵器在城門與街巷的狹窄處格鬥，亞述長矛那套「短柄長刃、貼身刺穿」的邏輯，正落在這一類的場合。陳方的應對是多重的：據江、據山、據城三重險要，閉門拒守，斷絕橋梁津渡，焚燒攻城器械，同時以騎兵在開闊處反擊隋軍的鋒芒，行列一旦拉開就側擊其側翼與糧隊。隋軍自己也犯過毛病：兵分太多，援軍與前隊脫節，遇雨則軍器受損，遇急則築壘不固。最大的短板是水軍，沒有足以壓制陳朝舟師的艦隊，江北再怎樣得手，也只是把陳朝往建康方向擠。六年後開皇九年正月，隋軍渡江初戰失利，蕭摩訶以火船焚燒隋軍戰船，隋軍死者以萬計，元氣大損；再攻時，陳軍列槊為陣、以車為城，隋軍改用專門的破陣器械攻破，陳軍死者亦以萬計。同一套戰術在此時與彼時的成敗，全看水軍、器械與後勤三者能否同時到位。
tacticsEn: In this first wave of the Kaihuang third year, Sui's aim was not to cross the river and destroy Chen at once, but to get a footing along the Yangtze. The official record is plain about it: Emperor Wen of Sui sent the commander-in-chief out by separate routes, the points of the army aimed at the outer towns of Chen in the middle and lower Yangtze, to seize the fords and cut the enemy's linkage, and only then to plant the base for grain and for the fleet in Jianghuai. The method of fighting was the standard combination of the day. First the crossbowmen deployed in echelon to press the shooting lines of the defenders on the wall and deny them a level shot; then the scaling ladders, siege towers, battering rams and stone-throwing engines came up to the walls, to batter the gates, block the fire lanes and pull down the banners; and once the gate was broken the foot soldiers entered in a mass with large shields and long sa spears, settling the business with short weapons in the narrow ground of the gate and the streets behind it. It is to this kind of moment that the Assyrian spear's logic of a short haft, a long blade and a thrust driven home at close range properly belongs. The Chen side had a many-layered answer: the triple difficulty of river, hill and walled town, gates shut and held, bridges and fords cut, siege machines burned; and at the same time the cavalry struck back at the Sui point wherever the ground opened out, and once the Sui line was stretched they hit its flank and its baggage train. The Sui army made its own mistakes as well: too many divided commands, relief falling away from the advance, weapons spoiled by rain, ramparts raised too hastily when pressed. Its gravest weakness was the navy. Without a fleet able to hold down the Chen war-ships, no amount of success north of the river did more than push Chen back towards Jiankang. Six years later, in the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang, the Sui army crossed the river and was beaten at the first: Xiao Mohe burned the Sui war-ships with fire boats, the Sui dead were put at ten thousand, and the army's strength was broken. On the second assault the Chen army set sa spears in line and made a wall of wagons, and the Sui answered with engines built to break exactly that, and the Chen dead were likewise put at ten thousand. Whether the same body of tactics succeeded or failed turned entirely on whether the navy, the engines and the supply line could all be in place at once.
data: 這場戰爭最要緊的一條數據，是它缺少數據。正史沒有為它留下獨立的戰役記，〈隋書〉與〈資治通鑑〉只在開皇三年伐陳的總敘中一筆帶過：雙方投入的兵員、兩軍的傷亡、確切的交戰日（除十月下詔、十一月接戰的概略順序外）、攻城所費的時日，都沒有可核的數目，因此任何關於此役兵力的精確說法都是編造，本篇只列站得住的。時間：開皇三年即西元583年，距開皇九年隋滅陳的589年整整六年，這場是六年裡的第一記。地理：合肥（在陳為秦州，隋平陳後改屬廬州）距建康約三百五十公里，開皇三年陳朝實際控制區的北界大致在合肥、巢湖、廬江這一線。建制：隋以行軍元帥統諸軍，諸王各領一路，宿將配屬，兵員以府兵與隨駕宿衛為主；陳則是州郡兵與宗室、將門部曲並行，蕭摩訶部是其中最精的一支。器量：《隋書》記開皇九年平陳時隋軍「五十餘萬」，那是史家的概數，反映的是一場傾國出動的量級；同年所造五牙大艦上置拍竿，能擲八十斤之石，黃龍艦長一百七十尺，約合五十米，這些是《資治通鑑》《隋書》明載的尺寸，說明隋的攻城能力是靠器械堆出來的。損失：開皇九年采石一役蕭摩訶焚隋軍戰船，隋軍死者史稱萬計；其後破陳軍槊陣車陣，陳軍死者亦稱萬計。583此役本身，無數可記。
dataEn: The most important figure about this war is that it has almost no figures. The official histories leave it no separate battle account: the Sui shu and the Zizhi Tongjian carry it in a single line within the general narrative of the campaign against Chen in the Kaihuang third year. The numbers of men committed on either side, the casualties of the two armies, the exact day of contact beyond the rough order of the order to march in the tenth month and the fighting in the eleventh, and the time the siege consumed — none of these survive in a checkable form, so any precise statement about the strength engaged here would be invention, and only what can be stood up is set out. On time: the Kaihuang third year is 583 CE, six full years before the Sui conquest of Chen in 589, and this was the first of those six. On geography: Hefei — Qin prefecture under Chen, transferred to Luzhou after the pacification — lies about three hundred and fifty kilometres from Jiankang, and the northern limit of the territory Chen actually held in 583 lay roughly along the line of Hefei, Chaohu and Lujiang. On organisation: Sui held the armies under a commander-in-chief, each prince taking one route with veteran generals attached, and the men came chiefly from the fu-bing and the imperial guard; Chen ran county and commandery troops alongside the households of the imperial clan and of the generals, and Xiao Mohe's command was the finest of them. On measurements: the Sui shu records that at the conquest of Chen in the ninth year of Kaihuang the Sui army was of more than five hundred thousand — a chronicler's round number, showing the scale of a national mobilisation, not a roll of names. The five-deck ships built that year carried stone-throwing beams that could hurl a stone of eighty jin, and the yellow-dragon ship was a hundred and seventy chi long, roughly fifty metres; these dimensions are plainly recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian and the Sui shu, and they show that Sui's siege capability was built up out of machines. On losses: at Caishi in the ninth year of Kaihuang, Xiao Mohe burned the Sui war-ships and the Sui dead are put at ten thousand; afterwards the Chen sa-line and wagon-wall were broken and the Chen dead are likewise put at ten thousand. For the fighting of 583 itself, there are no numbers to record.
cause: 三層原因疊在一起。第一層是體制：開皇三年三月，隋文帝罷六官為六曹，定三省六部，把相權一分為三，權歸尚書省，政令出於一門；行台尚書省之制也始於此年，諸道設行台，行軍元帥得以便宜行事。制度先行，兵才能調得動、令才能傳得下去，才具備同時在幾條戰線上用兵的行政能力，這才有開皇三年十月那紙出兵詔書。第二層是北方已定：北周留下的中原與河北經七年休整，府兵整編，屯田與漕運成網，關中的糧食可經洛陽、汴州一路東運，再順運河南下到淮南，而淮南的稻米與江南的物產又能反過來供養北方。第三層是陳的內部：陳後主在位，朝政競逐於宮闈與諫諍之間，宗室與將門各據一方，徵發與賦斂年年加重，而軍隊的戰備被史書評為「甲兵寡弱」；就在這樣的局面下，陳廷才在隋的第一次出手面前慌了手腳。第四層是長江的物理限制：隋要滅陳，必須先有一支能壓住陳朝舟師的水軍，而水軍要造在淮南，淮南要守住，所以583這一仗的真實任務，是把江淮的立足點、造船的木料與屯田的糧食一併拿到手。陳方的選擇則很明確：既然長江不可越，便守住江、據住險，把隋軍拖在江北，拖到隋軍師老兵疲。
causeEn: Three layers of cause lie one on top of another. The first is institutional. In the third month of the Kaihuang third year Emperor Wen of Sui abolished the six ministries of the Zhou system for the Six Divisions of the Department of State Affairs and set up the three departments and six ministries, splitting the chancellor's authority three ways and returning the power of decision to the Department of State Affairs, so that orders went out from a single door; the system of the Circuit Department of State Affairs also began in that year, with circuits set up in the various regions and the commander-in-chief empowered to act as the occasion required. Institutions came first, so that troops could be moved and orders could travel, and only then was there the administrative capacity to fight on several fronts at once; and only then was there the edict of the tenth month of the Kaihuang third year. The second layer is that the north had been settled: the Central Plain and Hebei inherited from Northern Zhou had had seven years to recover, the fu-bing were reorganised, and the tuntian fields and canal transport formed a network, so that the grain of Guanzhong could be carried east by Luoyang and Bianzhou and then south along the canal to Jianghuai, while the rice of Jianghuai and the produce of the south could in turn feed the north. The third layer is inside Chen: under Emperor Hou the business of the court was divided between the palace and the remonstrance of officials, the imperial clan and the military families each held their own ground, the levies and the exactions grew heavier every year, and the army's readiness was put down in the histories as slender in armour and few in number; it was in that condition that the Chen court lost its composure at the first blow from Sui. The fourth layer is the physical limit of the Yangtze. To destroy Chen, Sui needed a fleet capable of holding down the Chen war-ships, and such a fleet had to be built in Jianghuai, and Jianghuai had to be held. The real task of the war of 583, therefore, was to take the foothold in Jianghuai, the timber for building the ships and the grain of the tuntian fields all at once. The Chen side's choice was equally plain: since the Yangtze could not be crossed, hold the river, hold the difficult ground, and drag the Sui army up north of it until it should tire and lose its strength.
impact: 此役的價值不在一城一池，而在它把整場戰爭的結構定了下來。開皇三年之後，隋在江淮站穩，取得淮南行省的地位，揚州一線成為造船、屯田、積穀與練兵的基地；陳朝則被壓縮到長江以南，日後每次隋軍來伐，陳廷都要在「傾國而出」與「坐困江表」之間做一次殘酷的取捨，士氣與財政被一次次抽乾。到開皇九年，隋軍渡江，陳朝覆亡，陳後主被檻送長安，南北分裂至此結束。隋的統一並非只靠兵，也靠制度：三省六部、府兵、租調力役與開皇律把一個新王朝的骨架先立起來，而江南門第在隋唐時期的走向、江南的開發與運河的開鑿，都由此拉開序幕。運河尤其關鍵：583這場戰爭之後，隋在江淮修漕渠、置倉儲，開皇九年已能以水運承擔運兵輸糧，到大業元年再開通濟渠、連結黃河與長江水系，揚州與洛陽之間的運量成為王朝的命脈。運河餵養了隋唐，也加重了徭役與轉運之苦，隋末的亂兵正是沿著這些水道湧上北方；隋文帝若在583年就預見到這一層代價，未必會如此處置棋盤。對陳朝而言，這場戰爭的真正毀滅不在戰場，而在它之後每一次敗退所帶走的元氣。
impactEn: The worth of this war lay not in any single city or piece of ground but in the fact that it fixed the structure of the whole campaign. After the Kaihuang third year Sui stood firm in Jianghuai and gained the standing of the Jiangnan Circuit, and the line at Yangzhou became a base for building ships, farming tuntian fields, storing grain and drilling troops; Chen, for its part, was pressed back to the south of the Yangtze, and from then on, every time the Sui army came, the Chen court had to make a cruel choice between committing everything to a sortie and sitting besieged south of the river, with its morale and its finances drained again and again. In the ninth year of Kaihuang the Sui army crossed the river, Chen fell, Emperor Hou was carried off in a cage to Chang'an, and the division of north and south came to an end. Sui's unification rested on arms and on institutions alike: the three departments and six ministries, the fu-bing, the rent-and-labour system and the Kaihuang code built the skeleton of a new dynasty first, and from there the course of the great Jiangnan families in the Sui and Tang, the development of the south and the cutting of the canal all opened out. The canal was especially decisive: after the war of 583, Sui repaired waterways in Jianghuai and set up depots, and by the ninth year of Kaihuang water transport was already carrying the army's grain; in the first year of the Daye era the Tongji Canal was opened to link the Yellow River and the Yangtze systems, and the volume of traffic between Yangzhou and Luoyang became the lifeline of the dynasty. The canal fed the Sui and the Tang, and it also deepened the burden of corvée and transport, and the rebels of the late Sui came north precisely along those waterways. Had Emperor Wen foreseen that cost in 583, he might have played the board differently. For Chen, the real destruction of this war lay not on the battlefield but in the strength it took away with every later defeat.
result: 分開來說，這一仗是隋小勝、陳大敗。高寶寧所領的陳軍在合肥、巢湖一線的江北前線被隋軍擊破，本人兵敗被擒，或死於亂軍，所部潰散，所據城邑為隋軍所取，陳朝在長江中游的第一道外圍屏障被撕開。但隋軍止步於此：沒有水軍，沒有渡江，六年的滅陳工程才剛開頭。此後隋又多次出兵，陳則憑長江天險與完好城池相持，雙方在拉鋸中彼此消耗；直到開皇九年正月隋軍渡江，采石一役被蕭摩訶以火船焚去戰船而大挫，之後重整再攻，陳軍列槊為陣、以車為城的防線被專門的破陣器械攻破，陳軍死者以萬計，陳後主匿於景陽殿被執，陳朝亡國，江南各州相繼歸隋，高寶寧當年所守的江北方位，此時全部改旗易幟。回頭看，583這場是那條長線上的第一錘：它沒有打下江南，只打下了一個可以把江南包起來的岸線。
resultEn: Told separately, this engagement was a small victory for Sui and a heavy defeat for Chen. The Chen army led by Gao Baoning was broken by the Sui on the north-of-the-river front along the Hefei and Chaohu line; the man himself was defeated and captured, or perished in the rout; his troops scattered and the towns he had held were taken by the Sui, and the first outer barrier of the middle Yangtze was torn open in Chen's defence. But the Sui army stopped there. Without a navy there was no crossing, and the six years of work to destroy Chen had only just begun. Sui marched against Chen again and again afterwards, while Chen held on behind the Yangtze and its intact cities, and the two sides consumed each other in the see-saw. Only in the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang did the Sui cross: at Caishi they were badly shaken when Xiao Mohe burned their war-ships with fire boats, and after regrouping they attacked again, broke the Chen line of sa spears and wagon wall with engines built for the purpose, put the Chen dead at ten thousand, and took Emperor Hou, who had hidden himself in the Jingyang hall. Chen was destroyed, the commanderies of the south submitted one after another, and the northern position that Gao Baoning had once held now changed its flag entirely. Looking back, the war of 583 was the first blow on a very long line: it did not take the south, it only took the shore that could wrap the south in its arms.
